"""Select new cells from the already verified scientific contact figures."""
import io
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from core import colab_artifacts as a

f=Path('.benchmark/png-bmp-native-expansion-20261023')
current,previous=sys.argv[1:]
assert current.isdigit() and previous.isdigit()
target=f/'inspection-snapshots'/current
checks=a.document(target/'inspection.json')['checks']
old=a.document(f/'inspection-snapshots'/previous/'inspection.json')['checks']
prior={r['id']:r for r in old}
new={r['id'] for r in checks if r['id'] not in prior}
for row in checks:
 if row['id'] in prior:assert row['crop_sha256']==prior[row['id']]['crop_sha256'] and row['original_sha256']==prior[row['id']]['original_sha256']
for pair in a.document(target/'inspection.json')['similarity_flags']:
 if pair['left'] in new or pair['right'] in new:new.update([pair['left'],pair['right']])
selected=[(i,r) for i,r in enumerate(checks) if r['id'] in new]
assert 0<len(selected)<=24
figure=Image.new('RGB',(1200,300*((len(selected)+2)//3)),'white')
for cell,(index,row) in enumerate(selected):
 source=target/('full-and-crop-%02d.png'%(index//12))
 with Image.open(io.BytesIO(a.read(source,4*a.MIB))) as page:
  x,y=(index%3)*400,(index%12//3)*300
  figure.paste(page.crop((x,y,x+400,y+300)),((cell%3)*400,(cell//3)*300))
buffer=io.BytesIO();figure.save(buffer,format='PNG')
sha=a.put(target/'new-and-flagged-contact-sheet.png',buffer.getvalue(),8*a.MIB)
a.put(target/'new-contact-selection.json',a.encode({'ids':[r['id'] for _,r in selected],'figure_sha256':sha,'selector_sha256':a.digest(a.read(Path(__file__),a.MIB)),'unchanged_prior_hashes_verified':True,'previous_snapshot':previous}))
print('new/flagged cells',len(selected))

"""Generated visual-regression checks of new/flagged contact selection."""
import runpy
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from PIL import Image
from core import colab_artifacts as a

SELECTOR=Path(__file__).with_name('new_contact_sheet.py').absolute()

@pytest.fixture
def scene(tmp_path,monkeypatch):
 monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
 f=tmp_path/'.benchmark/png-bmp-native-expansion-20261023/inspection-snapshots'
 for name in ['000','001']:(f/name).mkdir(parents=True)
 old={'id':'old','original_sha256':'a'*64,'crop_sha256':'b'*64}
 new={'id':'new','original_sha256':'c'*64,'crop_sha256':'d'*64}
 (f/'000/inspection.json').write_bytes(a.encode({'checks':[old]}))
 current={'checks':[old,new],'similarity_flags':[{'left':'old','right':'new'}]}
 (f/'001/inspection.json').write_bytes(a.encode(current))
 figure=Image.new('RGB',(1200,1200),'white')
 figure.paste(Image.new('RGB',(400,300),'red'),(0,0))
 figure.paste(Image.new('RGB',(400,300),'blue'),(400,0))
 figure.save(f/'001/full-and-crop-00.png')
 monkeypatch.setattr(sys,'argv',[str(SELECTOR),'001','000'])
 return f,current


def test_flagged_prior_cell_is_shown_with_new_source(scene):
 f,current=scene
 runpy.run_path(str(SELECTOR),run_name='__main__')
 receipt=a.document(f/'001/new-contact-selection.json')
 assert receipt['ids']==['old','new']
 with Image.open(f/'001/new-and-flagged-contact-sheet.png') as output:
  assert output.getpixel((200,150))==(255,0,0)
  assert output.getpixel((600,150))==(0,0,255)


def test_changed_prior_source_cannot_inherit_visual_review(scene):
 f,current=scene
 current['checks'][0]['crop_sha256']='e'*64
 (f/'001/inspection.json').write_bytes(a.encode(current))
 with pytest.raises(AssertionError):runpy.run_path(str(SELECTOR),run_name='__main__')
 assert not (f/'001/new-and-flagged-contact-sheet.png').exists()
